Corta el plátano en rodajas finas y coló: Cut the banana into thin slices and lay them on top; the light weight will not break it.
Cut the banana into thin slices and lay them overlapping like roof tiles, so they do not fall off as you bite.
Corta el plátano en rodajas y colócalo p: Slice the banana and arrange it in its own area beside the berries rather than mixing everything: that way you choose what goes in each spoonful.
Corta el plátano en rodajas y ponlo por: Slice the banana and put it on top when you serve.
Corta el plátano en rodajas y repártelas: Slice the banana and scatter the slices over the top.
Slice the banana and scatter the slices over the top. Use pure unsweetened cocoa, not a drinking-chocolate mix: that is almost all sugar.
Slice the banana and spread it around.
Corta el plátano en rodajas, ponlo por e: Slice the banana, put it on top and add the honey at the end, off the heat.
Corta el plátano en rodajas, repártelo p: Slice the banana, scatter it over the top and finish with the walnuts broken up with your fingers.
Corta el pollo en dados de dos centímetr: Cut the chicken into two-centimetre cubes, pat them dry with paper and salt them.
Corta el pollo en dados pequeños, sécalo: Cut the chicken into small cubes, pat them dry, salt them and brown them for 5 minutes over a high heat with a tablespoon of oil.
Corta el pollo en dados, sécalos y sálal: Cut the chicken into cubes, pat them dry and salt them lightly. Go easy: teriyaki sauce is already very salty.
Corta el pollo en dados, sécalos, sálalo: Cut the chicken into cubes, pat them dry, salt them and brown them for 5 minutes over a high heat with a tablespoon of oil.
Corta el pollo en tiras, sécalas y sálal: Cut the chicken into strips, pat them dry and salt them.
Corta el pollo en tiras, sécalo, sálalo: Cut the chicken into strips, pat it dry, salt it and brown it for 4 minutes a side in the pan with a tablespoon of oil.
Corta el queso en dados o en lonchas, co: Cut the cheese into cubes or slices, whichever you prefer.
Corta el tomate en dados y mézclalo con: Cut the tomato into cubes and mix it into the hot rice, with salt. The heat of the rice is enough to draw out its juice, there is no need to fry it.
Corta el tomate en rodajas finas, escúrr: Cut the tomato into thin slices, drain them a moment on kitchen paper and lay them on top. Undrained, the bread goes soggy.
Corta el tomate y el pepino en dados del: Cut the tomato and the cucumber into cubes of the same size.
Cut the tomato and the cucumber into cubes.
Corta el tomate y el pepino en trozos y: Cut the tomato and the cucumber into pieces and dress them with the rest of the oil, salt and a squeeze of lemon or a splash of vinegar.
Corta en trozos y quita el tronco centra: Cut it into pieces and remove the core if it is tough.
Corta la batata en dados de dos centímet: Cut the sweet potato into two-centimetre cubes and spread it on the tray with a tablespoon of oil and salt.
Corta la cebolla, el pimiento y el calab: Cut the onion, the pepper and the courgette into one-centimetre cubes, each vegetable separately.
Corta la mozzarella en dados o rásgala c: Cut the mozzarella into cubes or tear it with your hands.
Corta la patata cocida en dados y calién: Cut the boiled potato into cubes and warm it with the broccoli for the last minute, or in the microwave.
Corta la patata cocida en dados y saltéa: Cut the boiled potato into cubes and fry it with a tablespoon of oil for 5 minutes until golden, or warm it with the carrot for the last minute.
Corta la patata en dados de tres centíme: Cut the potato into three-centimetre cubes and boil it in salted water for 12 minutes, until a knife goes in without resistance.
Cut the potato into three-centimetre cubes and put it on to boil in salted water for 12 minutes.
Corta la patata en rodajas de un centíme: Cut the potato into one-centimetre slices, spread them on the tray with a tablespoon of oil and salt, and bake for 15 minutes.
Corta la patata en rodajas finas y ponla: Cut the potato into thin slices and put them in the steamer for 8 minutes: it takes the longest, so it goes in first.
Corta la patata ya cocida en gajos y el: Cut the boiled potato into wedges and the chicken into large pieces. Keep everything a similar size so it cooks at the same rate.
Corta la patata ya cocida en rodajas gru: Cut the boiled potato into thick slices. Brown it in a pan with a tablespoon of oil over a medium-high heat for 4 minutes a side and take it out.
Corta la patata ya cocida en rodajas o d: Cut the boiled potato into slices or cubes and pat it dry with paper: wet, the tortilla will not set properly.
Corta la patata ya cocida en rodajas y d: Cut the boiled potato into slices and brown it in a pan with a tablespoon of oil for 3 minutes a side. Take it out.
Corta la patata ya cocida en rodajas y s: Cut the boiled potato into slices and pat it dry with paper: wet, the tortilla will not set.
Corta la pechuga de pavo en tiras finas,: Cut the turkey breast into thin strips, pat them dry and salt them. Turkey is drier than chicken: thin and not for long.
Corta la pechuga en dados pequeños y del: Cut the breast into small cubes of the same size, so they cook at the same rate. Pat them dry and salt them.
Corta la pechuga en dados, sécalos y sál: Cut the breast into cubes, pat them dry and salt them.
Cut the breast into cubes, pat them dry and salt them. Pan over a high heat with a tablespoon of oil, 5 minutes, until no pink is left. If you have soy sauce, a splash at the end.
Corta la pechuga en dados, secos y salad: Cut the breast into cubes, dried and salted. In the same pan, high heat, 5 minutes until no pink is left.
Cut the breast into cubes, dried and salted. Pan over a high heat with a tablespoon of oil, 5 minutes, until no pink is left. With oregano if you have some.
Cut the breast into cubes, dried and salted. Pan over a high heat, 5 minutes, until no pink is left.
Corta la pechuga en tiras, sécalas y sál: Cut the breast into strips, pat them dry and salt them.
Cut the breast into strips, pat them dry and salt them. Pan over a medium-high heat with a tablespoon of oil, 5 minutes, until no pink is left. Let it cool a little.
Corta la pechuga en trozos de dos centím: Cut the breast into two-centimetre pieces, pat them dry and salt them.
Corta la pechuga en trozos grandes, séca: Cut the breast into large pieces, pat it dry, salt it and put it on the same tray.
Corta la pechuga en trozos, sécalos y sá: Cut the breast into pieces, pat them dry and salt them.
Corta la ternera en tiras finas a contra: Cut the beef into thin strips against the grain, crossing the lines in the meat rather than following them.
Corta la ternera en tiras finas A CONTRA: Cut the beef into thin strips AGAINST THE GRAIN, that is, crossing the lines you can see in the meat rather than following them. Cut with the grain it stays tough however long you cook it.
Corta la ternera en tiras FINAS y CONTRA: Cut the beef into THIN strips AGAINST THE GRAIN (cross the lines in the meat, or it stays tough). Pat it dry and salt it.
Cut the beef into THIN strips AGAINST THE GRAIN (cross the lines or it stays tough), dried and salted.
Cut the beef into THIN strips AGAINST THE GRAIN (cross the lines or it stays tough), dried and salted. Highest heat, 2 minutes. No more.
Cut the beef into THIN strips AGAINST THE GRAIN, dried and salted.
Cut the beef into THIN strips AGAINST THE GRAIN: look at the lines running through the meat and cut across them. With the grain it stays tough however well you cook it.
Corta las patatas en rodajas de un centí: Cut the potatoes into one-centimetre slices and spread them on the tray with a tablespoon of oil and salt, in a single layer. Piled up they steam and do not brown.
Cut the potatoes into one-centimetre slices and put them on the tray with a tablespoon of oil and salt, in a single layer.
Corta las salchichas en rodajas y dórala: Slice the sausages and brown them in the pan over a medium-high heat, 4 minutes, until coloured outside. No oil needed: the sausage releases its own.
Corta las salchichas en rodajas y ponlas: Slice the sausages and put them in the pan over a medium heat: they release enough fat for everything else.
Corta los dos extremos de la naranja par: Cut both ends off the orange so it sits flat on the board and does not roll while you peel it.
Cut both ends off the orange so it sits flat and does not roll as you peel it.
Corta los huevos en rodajas, repártelos: Slice the eggs, scatter them over the top and salt.
Corta un trozo grande de papel de horno,: Cut a large piece of baking paper, twice the size you think you need.
Córtala en cuartos, quita el corazón con: Quarter it, cut out the core with the pips and cut each quarter into 3 or 4 wedges.
Córtala en rodajas de medio centímetro,: Cut it into half-centimetre slices, or tear it with your hands if you prefer uneven pieces.
Córtala en trozos y retira el tronco cen: Cut it into pieces and take out the core if it is tough.
Córtalo AL FINAL, justo antes de servir:: Cut it AT THE END, right before serving: it goes brown within minutes.
Córtalo en cuartos y ponlo encima al ser: Quarter it and put it on top when you serve. Check the seasoning.
Córtalo en dados de dos centímetros con: Cut it into two-centimetre cubes with the sharpest knife you have, in one long stroke: sawing at it makes it fall apart.
Córtalo en dados de dos centímetros y sá: Cut it into two-centimetre cubes and salt them.
Córtalo en dados y dóralos en una sartén: Cut it into cubes and brown them in a pan with a tablespoon of oil over a medium-high heat for 5 minutes. A splash of soy sauce at the end to glaze.
Córtalo en dados, sálalos. Sartén a fueg: Cut it into cubes, salt them. Pan over a medium-high heat with a tablespoon of oil; DO NOT TOUCH THEM for 4 minutes until they have a crust, then 3 minutes more, turning them.
Córtalo en diagonal para comerlo más cóm: Cut it diagonally to make it easier to eat.
Córtalo en filetes de un centímetro y sá: Cut it into one-centimetre steaks and salt them.
